description: SubmitFeed: submits a sitemap/feed URL to Bing for a project's matched site. FREE (no credits), but this is a MUTATION — unlike get_bing_site_overview, it queues real work on the operator's live Bing Webmaster account. Bring-your-own-key: requires BING_WEBMASTER_API_KEY. Answers { ok: false, reason: 'not_configured' } when unset, or 'no_matching_site' when the project's domain has no verified match on the account.

feedUrl.description: Absolute URL of the sitemap/feed to submit.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: submit_bing_feed
